integrity: Finite numerical checks corroborate a self-contained proof. The originality comparison covers stated primary sources and relevant published special cases, with the possibility of an unindexed general formulation remaining. No independent external validation was performed.
limitations: Singular values for arbitrary unequal orders are determined by the eigenvalues of an explicit finite real symmetric arrowhead-type matrix; no universal radical formula or phase of the Fourier minor is asserted. Previously published uniform-alphabet special cases are acknowledged.
title: Exact Fourier interpolation and determinant on mixed-alphabet coordinate crosses
